FORMAL CASE NO. EA2013-27, IN THE MATTER OF THE APPLICATION OF 
ENERGY SERVICES PROVIDERS, LLC D/B/A DC GAS & ELECTRIC, TO 
SURRENDER ITS ELECTRICITY SUPPLIER LICENSE IN THE DISTRICT OF 
COLUMBIA, Order No. 23138 

I. 
INTRODUCTION 
1. 
By this Order,1 the Public Service Commission of the District of Columbia 
(“Commission”) grants the request of Energy Services Providers, LLC d/b/a DC Gas & Electric 
(“Energy Services Providers” or “Applicant”) to surrender its electricity supplier license. 
Cancellation of the Applicant’s electricity supplier license is effective upon the issuance of this 
Order. 

II. 
BACKGROUND 
2. 
On November 15, 2013, the Commission granted Energy Services Providers a 
license to operate as an electricity supplier in the District of Columbia (“District”) in Order No. 
17300.2 On June 5, 2026, Energy Services Providers filed an Application with the Commission 
to surrender its electricity supplier license.3 Energy Services Providers was approved to operate 
as an aggregator of electricity services, but it conducts no business and has no customers in the 
District.4 Consequently, Energy Services Providers requests to surrender its electricity supplier 
license.5 

1

authority to act and issue orders on the following matters: . . . m. Applications for the Abandonment of Gas or Electric 
Licenses”). Any party may file a petition for reconsideration of the General Counsel’s decision with the Commission.

III. 
DISCUSSION 

3. 
According to 15 DCMR § 4602.10 (a)(1), a licensed electricity supplier wishing to 
cease providing services in the District is required to provide written notice to the Commission of 
the licensee’s intention to cease providing electricity service to its customers and inform its 
customers of the choice to revert to the default service provider or another electricity supplier. 
Section 4602.10 (a)(2) also requires that the surrendering licensee provide to the Commission an 
example or copy of the notice it provided to its customers and, upon the Commission’s receipt of 
such notice, may order the licensee to provide such further notice to its customers or the public as 
the Commission deems necessary, and/or take such other action that the Commission considers 
appropriate.6 

4. 
In the instant case, Energy Services Providers’ Application provides the required 
notice to the Commission of its intention to surrender its electricity supplier license.7 Energy 
Services Providers also states that the notice requirement to customers is not applicable because it 
has no customers in the District that would require notification.8 Accordingly, Energy Services 
Providers’ Application satisfies the notice requirement with regard to the cessation of service. 

5. 
In all other respects, Energy Services Providers’ Application conforms with 
Commission requirements for a surrendering licensee. Commission records confirm the 
Applicant’s submission of the case number, order number, and date the Applicant’s license was 
granted.9 Energy Services Providers avers, and Commission records confirm, that the Applicant’s 
most recent survey response indicates no jurisdictional revenue and that it owes no outstanding 
debt or fees.10 In addition, the Applicant states that it has no outstanding consumer complaints.11 
Lastly, the Applicant has submitted an affidavit from an officer of Energy Services Providers 
attesting to the truth and accuracy of the information submitted.12 

6. 
Based upon the preceding information, the Commission grants Energy Services 
Providers’ request to surrender its electricity supplier license granted by Order No. 17300. 
Cancellation of Energy Services Providers’ electricity supplier license shall become effective upon 
the issuance of this Order. Should Energy Services Providers seek to re-enter the District’s
